fields.note: Hexoloy SA Form B-1045, opened this check, heads the table Typical Physical Properties. It prints compressive strength 3900 MPa, four-point flexure 380 MPa, Weibull modulus 10, elastic modulus 430 GPa, Poisson 0.14, density 3.10 g/cm3, and flexure bars 3 x 4 x 45 mm. The card scores the inherited 410 GPa and says so. Density matches. The same-bay factors at 430 GPa are recorded and are not a new optimum and not a qualified allowable.
